description: A controller annotation that writes every return value to the response body, usually as JSON.
The annotations that bind an HTTP method and path to a handler method, such as @GetMapping and @PostMapping.
A record that defines exactly what a client sends or receives, kept separate from the domain model.
A return type that lets a handler choose the status code, headers and body of the response.
The header of a 201 Created response that holds the URL of the new resource.
The split of controller for HTTP, service for rules and repository for storage, each knowing only the layer below.
A mapping version attribute resolved from a header, path segment or query parameter, available in Spring Framework 7.
